WDS Rising Star 3 summary

WDS Rising Star 3 took place on 22 June 2025 at Bhanushali Wadi, Nerul, Navi Mumbai. The card had 9 bouts (9 amateur). 1 of the 9 decided bouts ended inside the distance by knockout, TKO or submission. In the main event, Vijay Yadav beat Preshit Golait by unanimous decision.
